text:
SANCTUARIES FOR THE SENSES
What Makes Us Different
We uphold the pinnacle of mastery in crafting luxury custom homes. Our distinguishing factor is our innovative spirit – an innovation that shines through the meticulous details and distinctive features we incorporate into every build.
About Us
Shideh and Loy Lowary epitomize sophistication and excellence at Ventura Custom Homes, boasting over 70 years of combined experience where their expertise and visionary leadership set a new standard in luxury homebuilding. Loy’s background as a former owner of a commercial concrete company grants Ventura a strategic advantage, especially in navigating challenging terrain and creating exceptional basements—a skill they’ve perfected since the 90s when soil conditions deterred others. Their commitment to pushing boundaries and embracing the cutting edge ensures Ventura stays at the forefront of innovation, offering clients nothing short of perfection.
Complementing Loy’s technical expertise is Shideh’s innate talent for design, crafting homes that serve as “sanctuaries for the senses”. Her meticulous attention to detail ensures every aspect of Ventura’s homes exudes elegance and refinement. Shideh’s dedication to exposing her team to all aspects of custom home construction underscores Ventura’s commitment to excellence in design. Under her guidance, employees flourish, many venturing into successful ventures in residential construction and design. Together, Shideh and Loy embody elegance and distinction, propelling Ventura Custom Homes to unparalleled levels of luxury and sophistication in the industry.

text:
Home » About
Play Video
Our Story
ExecutivesLoy and Shideh Lowary transform spaces into luxurious, award-winning residences by seamlessly blending clients' personalities with their unmatched creativity,
FounderShideh Lowary
Shideh Lowary holds a degree from Southern Illinois University in Accounting. She began her career in California working for a top Fortune 500 Company as a financial planner. Shideh entered into real estate in 1988 as a mortgage loan officer, and quickly advanced to Regional Manager with more than 200 direct reports. For 15 years she gained comprehensive insight into residential construction loans and the building and loan funding process; during this time she honed and developed an innovative management style and attention to detail, as well as learning the art of doing business. What Shideh brings to Ventura is a special gift in helping customers and employees alike to realize their dream. She provides sound leadership with an open and honest management style that allows Ventura employees to grow to their full potential. As a true leader, Shideh’s goal is to expose her employees to all aspects of building a custom home from the initial creative meeting to the final product completion walk-through. So passionate and skilled is Shideh at managing people that over the past 10 year many Ventura employees have gone on to start their own successful companies either building residential homes or starting their own design firm.
FounderLoy Lowary
Loy Lowary is a graduate of Arizona State University where he earned a degree in Finance. While attending Arizona State University, Loy found his true calling, in the field of construction. Loy began his construction career in 1975, honing his skills by working on large projects such as building public schools, power and chemical plants. With this knowledge as his foundation, he started a commercial and residential excavation and concrete contracting company. Loy worked on excavation and paving projects including UA Cinemas, City of Colony Municipal Buildings, City of Dallas Municipal parking lots and various restaurants throughout the Dallas-Fort Worth area. Sensing his knowledge in commercial construction was solidified, Loy began his pursuit of the same knowledge base for residential construction. In 1982, he began his career by overseeing the residential construction of more than 400 homes in Dallas, Texas and New England. In addition, he gained further knowledge by overseeing the building of a commercial 120-unit four-story luxury facility in Topsham, Maine. In the process he gained valuable and rare knowledge on building residential homes with basements, including excavation, installation and difficult sloping hillside sites. Combining his knowledge of commercial and residential construction, Loy is able to provide clients with extensive experience and technical expertise for building on some of Texas’s most challenging lots — the most recent being a 26,000 square foot, 4-level residence with a foundation so complex Ventura used the services of a commercial concrete company.
OUR HISTORY
Decades of Excellence & Experience
With over 70 years of combined experience, no other builder comes close to Loy Lowary’s knowledge of building on Texas soil. Homes on The Preserve require walk-out basements, and it takes a special art form mixed with decades of experience to build a contemporary and transitional basement effectively.

text:
Home » Recognition
RECOGNIZED WITH 20+ AWARDSAward-Winning DesignVentura Custom Homes, a renowned builder known for its excellence in home construction, stands as a beacon of quality and innovation in the industry. Led by Shideh and Loy Lowary, their commitment to craftsmanship and design has earned them widespread recognition, including prestigious awards and features in high-profile magazines like Traditional Home.From their acclaimed presence at the Parade of Homes to showcasing masterpieces like the Spanish-Mediterranean styled project on Beverly Drive in Highland Park, Ventura demonstrates unparalleled expertise in creating luxurious, functional spaces that exceed client expectations. This blend of elegance, functionality, and client-focused innovation solidifies Ventura Custom Homes' status as a trusted leader in the luxury home building sector, highlighting their track record of exceptional residences.
Ventura Takes Peoples Choice Honors at Parade Of HomesFor the second consecutive year, Ventura Custom Homes won the People's Choice award at the Parade of Homes®, recognized for their exceptional design, including a showhome with unique features like a pond foyer and swim-up wine cellar, reflecting their popularity and design excellence.
Ventura Custom Homes Named Best of ShowVentura Custom Homes was recognized as a leading force in the Parade of Homes®, winning "Best of Show - First Place" and multiple other awards, highlighting their exceptional design, craftsmanship, and community involvement.
Ventura Custom Homes Named Best of Show at Parade of HomesVentura Custom Homes was celebrated at the Parade of Homes, winning "Best of Show - First Place" and multiple categories, highlighting their innovation, design excellence, and comprehensive team effort in custom home building.
McSam Awards "Luxury Home of the Year" WinnerVentura Custom Homes was awarded "Luxury Home of the Year" for a home priced over $750,000 at the McSam Awards, marking their leadership and excellence in the luxury residential construction market.
Ventura Recognized as Dallas 100 General ContractorVentura Custom Homes Inc. was recognized 88th in the Dallas 100 Awards, celebrating significant sales growth among North Texas small and medium-sized companies, highlighting its success in the competitive residential construction market.
Ventura Shows in ParadeVentura Custom Homes showcased an African contemporary show home at the Parade of Homes®, featuring a unique 20-foot rondoval with a skylight, master suites, and a private oasis outdoor area, exemplifying their commitment to exceptional craftsmanship and immersive environments.
Traditional HomeVentura Custom Homes' bedroom design by Shideh Lowrey, featured on Traditional Home magazine's cover, presents a show-house bedroom in Plano, Texas, that combines tropical inspiration with natural materials and safari-inspired fabrics, creating an immersive escape that exemplifies Ventura's innovative approach to home design.
Traditional Home Decorator ShowcaseFeatured in the Traditional Home Decorator Showcase, Ventura Custom Homes designed a Tuscan villa-inspired kitchen that blends traditional charm with modern functionality, featuring custom wrought-iron tables, an Austin stone wall with a recessed stove and pizza oven, and hand-painted cabinets concealing modern appliances, illustrating Ventura's expertise in creating inspired, functional living spaces.
Upscale homes reflect growing sophistication of home buyersIn Dallas, affluent homebuyers are favoring elegant, custom-built homes in Preston Hollow, with trends towards technology integration, hidden commercial kitchen appliances, spa-like bathrooms, and adaptable living spaces, alongside a preference for period-looking architecture and low-maintenance homes in gated communities.
Homebuilder Creates Splash on Beverly Dr.Ventura Custom Homes, under Loy and Shideh Lowary, debuted a $9.75 million Spanish-Mediterranean style home in Highland Park, exemplifying luxury with 11,274 square feet of top-notch craftsmanship, innovative design by architect Will Snyder, and a focus on natural light and high-end finishes, marking their distinguished presence in the luxury Texas market.
Pinnacle MagazineVentura Custom Homes was featured on the cover of a pinnacle magazine, emphasizing their luxury home-building expertise with properties that showcase architectural elegance and modern sophistication in prestigious neighborhoods, reflecting the sophisticated tastes of affluent buyers.

text:
Home » careers
Superintendent
Ventura Custom Homes is currently looking for a Superintendent who has experience in coordinating and directing job site activities; including review of architectural and engineering plans, details, and specifications; experience with shop drawings compliance to job conditions and contract documents; dealing directly with architects, engineers, designers and sub-contractors on verification of cost control measures and elevations; strict adherence to OSHA compliance and job safety.
The candidate should have a Bachelor’s Degree with emphasis in Construction Technology preferred: a minimum of 10 years’ experience as a superintendent with a strong client focus, high reputation for quality, professional appearance and manner; highly organized and detailed.
Send Your Resume
Office Assistant
Ventura Custom Homes is currently looking for an office assistant who has experience in coordinating and directing office activities and will be responsible for and have a proactive approach to office and facility related oversight and support; work with our interior design team by handling administrative and project related tasks; assist field superintendents with various administrative steps of the construction project.
The candidate should have Bachelor’s Degree in a related field, a minimum of 2 years’ experience in a professional construction firm preferred. Strong project management skills; ability to handle multiple competing priorities; strong client focus; high reputation for quality, professional appearance and manner; highly organized and detailed. Excellent MS Office & QuickBooks a must.
Send Your Resume
